verdict.summary: Addressing remains architecturally strong and broadly instrumented for RC validation, but the current repository cannot be considered all-green: the read-only RC validation is blocked because the default composer phpstan path loads phpstan.neon containing two unsupported PHPStan configuration keys. Composer validation, repository-wide PHP lint, and Composer security audit are green. The existing runtime on port 8000 is not running, so behavioral/UI evidence was not verified; no restart was performed under the READ_ONLY and REUSE_EXISTING_FIRST contract.
strengths: Symfony 8.1 / PHP 8.4 dependency baseline with explicit component dependencies and a substantial Symfony-oriented Addressing implementation.
Broad QA surface is present: PHPStan, Psalm, PHPUnit suites, Deptrac, Rector, PHP-CS-Fixer, Gating, security checks, Panther, Playwright, smoke probes, Doctrine parity checks, and inspection reports.
Repository PHP lint passed for 209 PHP files during RC validation.
composer audit reported no security vulnerability advisories.
RC validator found no blocking canon violations; the two canon findings are warning-level TODO/placeholder markers.
Visual Gallery service is healthy and reachable.
risks: Current composer phpstan fails before analysis because phpstan.neon contains unsupported checkMissingIterableValueType and checkGenericClassInNonGenericObjectType settings.
The assessed HEAD remains on rc/addressing-rc-final-v3 without an exact release tag.
A pre-existing modification to .gating/README.md remains in the working tree and was deliberately left untouched.
The managed Addressing PHP runtime on 127.0.0.1:8000 is not running, so runtime, Panther, Playwright, and user-flow behavior were not verified in this read-only assessment.
No current all-green aggregate evidence bundle was established for PHPStan, PHPUnit, Gating, Deptrac, Rector, style, security, Doctrine parity, and E2E together.
next_actions: Reconcile phpstan.neon with the current PHPStan 2.x configuration surface; phpstan.neon.dist already omits the two unsupported keys.
After the PHPStan configuration is corrected in a WRITE_ALLOWED task, rerun composer phpstan and the repository's canonical qa/full and gating paths.
Run the applicable PHPUnit, security, Doctrine parity, and dependency-boundary checks and retain an all-green RC evidence bundle.

For a task requiring behavioral/UI acceptance, reuse an existing healthy runtime if available or start it only under appropriate write/runtime authority, then execute the configured Panther/Playwright paths and capture visual evidence under the central workspace artifact contract.
Keep the pre-existing .gating/README.md work isolated unless its owner explicitly includes it in the RC closure.
Only after deterministic gates are green should the RC branch reconciliation and exact release tagging be treated as closure work.
notes: No repository source, configuration, Git staging, commit, push, or destructive mutation was performed.
The RC validator was invoked with evidence writing disabled; its modeled var/rc-run paths were not persisted.
The RC validation command classified the PHPStan failure as configuration_failure with readiness blocker validation_failed.
